Name: Purple For Abigail
Author: annakacey
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Gives a friendship bonus (+2 hearts) when you gift a purple item to Abigail.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the ZIP file[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Unzip the folder[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Place the folder into Stardew's "Mods" folder[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]4. Run the game with SMAPI[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Makes items with the "color_purple" context tag loved gifts for Abigail when you gift them, and gives you 420 extra friendship points along with the 80 points you get from loved gifts, resulting in 500 points/2 hearts gained![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you Abigail for being obsessed with amethyst :)[/color][/size]
